name: DashCore
description: Android64 Bismuth-inspired rendering diagnostics for Geometry Dash. Extends Android64 performance sampling to 600 frames and reduces report frequency. Adds clearer trigger/grouped-object census diagnostics; GPU visibility remains diagnostic only and live render culling is hard-disabled.

experimental-render-culling.name: Experimental render culling (locked off)
experimental-render-culling.description: Reserved for future testing. DashCore 0.8.2 hard-disables live object hiding; all grouped objects, triggers, and effects remain protected.
